mark.label: Nested apertures reducing toward a focal point

semanticColorUsage.background: The page canvas behind every surface.
semanticColorUsage.foreground: Primary text and high emphasis symbols.
semanticColorUsage.card: Grouped content and raised working surfaces.
semanticColorUsage.muted: Subdued regions, secondary controls, and quiet fills.
semanticColorUsage.border: Separators, control outlines, and structural rules.
semanticColorUsage.primary: Primary actions, selection, and active emphasis.
semanticColorUsage.primaryForeground: Content placed on the primary color.
semanticColorUsage.warning: Caution that needs attention without blocking work.
semanticColorUsage.ring: Keyboard focus indication around interactive controls.

display.usage: Singular page statements and expressive product moments.

heading.usage: Section hierarchy and important grouped content.

body.usage: Reading text, explanations, and form guidance.

label.usage: Compact labels, metadata, and interface wayfinding.

code.usage: Commands, values, identifiers, and technical evidence.

3.usage: Compact control internals and paired labels.

12.usage: Major sections and page level separation.

16.usage: Large media group and page section separation.

24.usage: Largest focal transitions around media and hero regions.

layout.guidance: Frame one focal subject at a time, use stark scale changes for hierarchy, and keep chrome subordinate to content.

mobile.guidance: Use one content column and preserve source order.

tablet.guidance: Introduce paired regions only when each remains independently readable.

desktop.guidance: Use the full grid while keeping reading lines constrained.

zoom.guidance: Allow controls and content to wrap without clipping or overlap.

reflow.guidance: Retain every action and meaning in a single logical flow.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, and compact interactive surfaces.

panel.usage: Cards, panels, and larger grouped regions.

pill.usage: Buttons and standalone inputs that form one control group.

strong.usage: Selected, focused, or strongly separated regions.

flat.usage: Default surfaces separated by spacing or borders.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, menus, and content above the working plane.

buttons.guidance: Use stark value contrast and compact labels so actions remain clear around visual work.

states.default: Use decisive monochrome contrast and a direct verb.
states.hover: Invert or strengthen value without changing geometry.
states.focus: Draw a high contrast focus frame outside the edge.
states.active: Compress visual emphasis without moving the layout.
states.disabled: Reduce emphasis while preserving the label.
states.loading: Keep the verb visible beside a compact busy indicator.
states.success: Use a textual confirmation with the success role.
states.error: Use a textual failure with the destructive role.

links.guidance: Underline destinations and keep them visually distinct from adjacent labels.

states.default: Use a persistent underline and direct destination label.
states.hover: Increase contrast without changing text measure.
states.focus: Draw the same high contrast frame used by buttons.
states.active: Hold the destination label steady during activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as plain text.
states.loading: Add a textual busy state without removing the label.
states.success: Name the completed local action next to the link.
states.error: Name the failed local action next to the link.

forms.guidance: Keep fields sparse, labels explicit, and validation aligned to the same visual axis.
forms.help: Use an address that can receive the export notice.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Describe the crop, sequence, or visual intent.
inputs.guidance: Use hard edges, compact spacing, and labels that remain distinct from values.

cards.title: Selected frame
cards.description: A focal card isolates one visual object and the minimum useful context around it.
cards.guidance: Use strong scale shifts and clear edges to make the selected content unmistakable.

panels.title: Contact sheet
panels.description: A bounded panel keeps adjacent visual records aligned and comparable.
panels.guidance: Use panels for comparison, with rules and alignment carrying the hierarchy.

navigation.label: Workspace views
navigation.guidance: Keep the selected view explicit with text, border, and programmatic current state.

listItems.title: Sequence
listItems.description: Third frame in the working set.

dataDisplay.guidance: Use hard rules, stark alignment, and compact labels to make visual records comparable.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Keep the comparison grid whole inside a labelled horizontal scroll region at narrow widths.

badges.label: Archived
badges.meaning: The frame is retained outside the active set

badges.label: Review
badges.meaning: The frame needs a visual decision

badges.label: Selected
badges.meaning: The frame is in the active export

alerts.title: Export ready
alerts.description: Every selected frame has complete metadata.

alerts.title: Source frame missing
alerts.description: Restore Frame 017 before exporting this sequence.

states.empty: No frames are in this contact sheet.
states.filteredEmpty: No frames match the selected format.
states.error: Frame metadata could not be loaded. Try again locally.
states.success: The selected frames are ready to export.
states.disabled: Export is unavailable while a source frame is missing.
states.destructive: Removing this frame changes the local sequence.

feedback.guidance: Keep status terse, adjacent to the frame, and explicit about what changed.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Combine each tone with a written state, distinct border, and recognizable symbol.

dialogs.title: Inspect frame details
dialogs.description: Review the selected frame metadata without leaving the contact sheet.
dialogs.guidance: Frame the focused object clearly and keep the dialog actions compact.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes inspection because no export or removal is in progress.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the frame details control.

destructiveActions.consequence: The frame will leave the local export sequence.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This specimen can restore the frame because it has no persistence.
destructiveActions.guidance: Keep the selected frame visible in the language and state how the sequence changes.

motion.guidance: Use direct focal movement with restrained timing and an immediately legible end state.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation and scaling while preserving an immediate labelled state change.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, tables, lists, and status regions before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep every action reachable and operable in a logical source and tab order.
accessibility.focus: Show a persistent high contrast focus indicator and restore focus after modal interactions.
accessibility.contrast: Meet text, icon, control boundary, and state contrast in both supported color schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing between adjacent actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve content and operation at 200 percent page zoom without overlap or clipping.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow to a 320 CSS pixel viewport without two dimensional page scrolling.
accessibility.forcedColors: Retain boundaries, focus, selection, and status meaning when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce asynchronous and local state changes in named status or alert regions without relying on color.
